mapper.select: SELECT im1.id, im1.app_code, im1.parent_code, im1.menu_code, im1.menu_name, im1.icon, im1.menu_type, im1.route_path, im1.component, im1.button_code, im1.hidden, im1.sort, im1.create_time, im1.create_by, im1.update_time, im1.update_by, im1.remark, im1.version, ( SELECT COUNT( * ) FROM iam_menu im2 WHERE im2.parent_code = im1.menu_code AND im2.app_code = im1.app_code AND im2.deleted = 0 ) children_count, ( SELECT COUNT( * ) FROM iam_menu_api ma WHERE ma.menu_code = im1.menu_code AND ma.deleted = 0 ) api_bind_count FROM iam_menu im1 WHERE im1.deleted = 0 AND im1.app_code = #{appCode} ORDER BY im1.sort, im1.id

SELECT `id`, `app_code`, `parent_code`, `menu_code`, `menu_name`, `icon`, `menu_type`, `route_path`, `component`, `button_code`, `hidden`, `sort`, `create_time`, `create_by`, `update_time`, `update_by`, `remark`, `version` FROM iam_menu WHERE deleted = 0 AND app_code IN ( #{item} ) ORDER BY sort, id
SELECT id, app_code, parent_code, menu_code, menu_name, menu_type, version FROM iam_menu WHERE deleted = 0 AND menu_code IN ( #{item} )
mapper.update: UPDATE iam_menu SET app_code = CASE id WHEN #{item.id} THEN #{item.appCode} END, parent_code = CASE id WHEN #{item.id} THEN #{item.parentCode} END, menu_name = CASE id WHEN #{item.id} THEN #{item.menuName} END, icon = CASE id WHEN #{item.id} THEN #{item.icon} END, menu_type = CASE id WHEN #{item.id} THEN #{item.menuType} END, route_path = CASE id WHEN #{item.id} THEN #{item.routePath} END, component = CASE id WHEN #{item.id} THEN #{item.component} END, button_code = CASE id WHEN #{item.id} THEN #{item.buttonCode} END, hidden = CASE id WHEN #{item.id} THEN #{item.hidden} END, remark = CASE id WHEN #{item.id} THEN #{item.remark} END, sort = CASE id WHEN #{item.id} THEN #{item.sort} END, update_by = CASE id WHEN #{item.id} THEN #{item.updateBy} END, version = version + 1 WHERE deleted = 0 AND id IN ( #{item.id} )
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT m.* FROM iam_user_role ur INNER JOIN iam_role_menu rm ON rm.role_code = ur.role_code INNER JOIN iam_menu m ON m.menu_code = rm.menu_code WHERE ur.deleted = 0 AND rm.deleted = 0 AND m.deleted = 0 AND ur.user_code = #{userCode} AND ur.app_code = #{appCode} ORDER BY m.sort ASC, m.id ASC
